title: Overrides in force, from the trail alone
heading: The Trail Records Who, When, Why and the Bounds That Moved, and Is Only Ever Appended To
cases: two set entries on two projects are both in force
a second set on the same project replaces the first
entries listed out of order are replayed by their sequence numbers
a revoked override and a refused request leave nothing in force
a clear entry ends every override set before it, inherited ones included
